items.e: Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir narrated from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s), peace be upon him, that he said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “When four things become widespread, four things will appear. When fornication becomes widespread, earthquakes will appear. When zakat is withheld, livestock will perish. When judges act unjustly in rulings, rain from the sky will be withheld. And when the covenant (with God (azj) and His (azj) creation) is violated, the polytheists will be granted victory over the Muslims.”
items.o: رَوَى عَبْدُ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ اَلصَّادِقِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« إِذَا فَشَتْ أَرْبَعَةٌ ظَهَرَتْ أَرْبَعَةٌ إِذَا فَشَا اَلزِّنَا ظَهَرَتِ اَلزَّلاَزِلُ وَ إِذَا أُمْسِكَتِ اَلزَّكَاةُ هَلَكَتِ اَلْمَاشِيَةُ وَ إِذَا جَارَ اَلْحُكَّامُ فِي اَلْقَضَاءِ أُمْسِكَ اَلْقَطْرُ مِنَ اَلسَّمَاءِ وَ إِذَا خُفِرَتِ اَلذِّمَّةُ نُصِرَ اَلْمُشْرِكُونَ عَلَى اَلْمُسْلِمِينَ»
items.h: Chapter on the Prayer for Seeking Rain

items.e: And it is narrated from the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, that He (saws) said: Prophet Muhammad (saws) said: “When Allah (swt), the Exalted, becomes angry with a nation, yet does not send punishment upon it, their prices rise, their lifespans become short, their merchants do not profit, their fruits do not increase, their rivers lose sweetness, their rains are withheld, and their wicked ones are given authority over them.”
items.o: وَ رُوِيَ عَنِ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« إِذَا غَضِبَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَلَى أُمَّةٍ ثُمَّ لَمْ يُنْزِلْ بِهَا اَلْعَذَابَ غَلَتْ أَسْعَارُهَا وَقَصُرَتْ أَعْمَارُهَا وَ لَمْ تَرْبَحْ تُجَّارُهَا وَ لَمْ تَزْكُ ثِمَارُهَا وَ لَمْ تَعْذُبْ أَنْهَارُهَا وَحُبِسَ عَنْهَا أَمْطَارُهَا وَسُلِّطَ عَلَيْهَا أَشْرَارُهَا»

items.e: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Hammad al-Sarraj: Muhammad ibn Khalid sent me to Abu Abdillah (a.s), to ask Imam (a.s): “The people have persistently asked me regarding seeking rain (istisqa), what is your opinion about going out tomorrow (to seek rain)?” So I conveyed this to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him. Imam (a.s) said: “Say to him (ibn Khalid); This is not how istisqa is to be done. Say to him (ibn Khalid); He should go out and deliver a sermon to the people and command them to fast today and tomorrow and then on the third day, he should go out with them, while they are fasting.” He (al-Sarraj) said: “So I went to Muhammad (ibn Khalid) and informed him of the words of Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him. So he (ibn Khalid) went and delivered a sermon to the people and commanded them to fast, just as Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, had said. Then, on the third day, he (ibn Khalid) sent to Imam (a.s) asking: “What is your opinion about going out (today)?”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلصَّفَّارُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَمَّادٍ اَلسَّرَّاجِ قَالَ: أَرْسَلَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَقُولُ لَهُ إِنَّ اَلنَّاسَ قَدْ أَكْثَرُوا عَلَيَّ فِي اَلاِسْتِسْقَاءِ فَمَا رَأْيُكَ فِي اَلْخُرُوجِ غَداً فَقُلْتُ ذَلِكَ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ لِي« قُلْ لَهُ لَيْسَ اَلاِسْتِسْقَاءُ هَكَذَا فَقُلْ لَهُ يَخْرُجُ فَيَخْطُبُ اَلنَّاسَ وَ يَأْمُرُهُمْ بِالصِّيَامِ اَلْيَوْمَ وَ غَداً وَ يَخْرُجُ بِهِمُ اَلْيَوْمَ اَلثَّالِثَ وَ هُمْ صِيَامٌ» قَالَ فَأَتَيْتُ مُحَمَّداً فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِمَقَالَةِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَجَاءَ فَخَطَبَ اَلنَّاسَ وَأَمَرَهُمْ بِالصِّيَامِ كَمَا قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَلَمَّا كَانَ فِي اَلْيَوْمِ اَلثَّالِثِ أَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ مَا رَأْيُكَ فِي اَلْخُرُوجِ

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Safwan, from Abdillah ibn Bukayr, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say regarding istisqa (the prayer for seeking rain); “He prays two rak’ahs, then turns his cloak placing what is on his right side to his left, and what is on his left side to his right and he supplicates to Allah (swt) and seeks rain.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: فِي اَلاِسْتِسْقَاءِ قَالَ« يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ يَقْلِبُ رِدَاءَهُ اَلَّذِي عَلَى يَمِينِهِ فَيَجْعَلُهُ عَلَى يَسَارِهِ وَ اَلَّذِي عَلَى يَسَارِهِ عَلَى يَمِينِهِ وَ يَدْعُو اَللَّهَ فَيَسْتَسْقِي»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, and al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Abdillah ibn Amir, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Ahmad ibn Sulayman, all from Murrah, the mawla (client) of Khalid, who said: The people of Madinah cried out to Muhammad ibn Khalid concerning istisqa (seeking rain), so Khalid said to me (Murrah): “Go to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, and ask Imam (a.s); ‘What is your opinion? For these people have turned to me.’” So I came to Imam (a.s) and conveyed to him what Khalid said to me. Imam (a.s) said to me: “Say to Khalid; ‘Let him go out.’” I asked Imam (a.s): “When should he go out, may I be your ransom?” Imam (a.s) said: “On Monday.” I asked Imam (a.s): “How should he do it?” Imam (a.s) said: “He should bring out the pulpit, then he should go out walking, just as he goes out on the two Eids, with the callers to prayer (mu’adhdhins) going before him, holding their staffs in their hands. When he reaches the place of prayer (musalla), he should lead the people in two rak’ahs, without any adhan or iqamah. Then he should ascend the pulpit and turn his cloak, placing what is on his right side to his left, and what is on his left to his right. Then he should face the qiblah and proclaim ‘Allahu Akbar’ one hundred times, raising his voice with it. Then he should turn to the people on his right and proclaim ‘SubhanAllah’ one hundred times, raising his voice. Then he should turn to the people on his left and proclaim ‘La ilaha illa Allah’ one hundred times, raising his voice. Then he should face the people and praise Allah (swt) (‘Alhamdulillah’) one hundred times. Then he should raise his hands and supplicate, and then the people should supplicate. For indeed, I hope that they will not be disappointed.” He (the narrator) said: “So Khalid did as instructed. And when we returned, the people said: ‘This is from the teachings of Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him.’”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ وَ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ جَمِيعاً عَنْ مُرَّةَ مَوْلَى خَالِدٍ قَالَ: صَاحَ أَهْلُ اَلْمَدِينَةِ إِلَى مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ فِي اَلاِسْتِسْقَاءِ فَقَالَ لِي اِنْطَلِقْ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَسَلْهُ مَا رَأْيُكَ فَإِنَّ هَؤُلاَءِ قَدْ صَاحُوا إِلَيَّ فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ مَا قَالَ لِي فَقَالَ لِي« قُلْ لَهُ فَلْيَخْرُجْ» قُلْتُ لَهُ مَتَى يَخْرُجُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ قَالَ« يَوْمَ اَلْإِثْنَيْنِ» قُلْتُ لَهُ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ« يُخْرِجُ اَلْمِنْبَرَ ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ يَمْشِي كَمَا يَخْرُجُ يَوْمَ اَلْعِيدَيْنِ وَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ اَلْمُؤَذِّنُونَ فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ عَنَزُهُمْ حَتَّى إِذَا اِنْتَهَى إِلَى اَلْمُصَلَّى صَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ بِلاَ أَذَانٍ وَ لاَ إِقَامَةٍ ثُمَّ يَصْعَدُ اَلْمِنْبَرَ فَيَقْلِبُ رِدَاءَهُ فَيَجْعَلُ اَلَّذِي عَلَى يَمِينِهِ عَلَى يَسَارِهِ وَ اَلَّذِي عَلَى يَسَارِهِ عَلَى يَمِينِهِ ثُمَّ يَسْتَقْبِلُ اَلْقِبْلَةَ فَيُكَبِّرُ اَللَّهَ مِائَةَ تَكْبِيرَةٍ رَافِعاً بِهَا صَوْتَهُ ثُمَّ يَلْتَفِتُ إِلَى اَلنَّاسِ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ فَيُسَبِّحُ اَللَّهَ مِائَةَ تَسْبِيحَةٍ رَافِعاً بِهَا صَوْتَهُ ثُمَّ يَلْتَفِتُ إِلَى اَلنَّاسِ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ فَيُهَلِّلُ اَللَّهَ مِائَةَ تَهْلِيلَةٍ رَافِعاً بِهَا صَوْتَهُ ثُمَّ يَسْتَقْبِلُ اَلنَّاسَ فَيَحْمَدُ اَللَّهَ مِائَةَ تَحْمِيدَةٍ ثُمَّ يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ فَيَدْعُو ثُمَّ يَدْعُونَ فَإِنِّي لَأَرْجُو أَنْ لاَ يَخِيبُوا» قَالَ فَفَعَلَ فَلَمَّا رَجَعْنَا قَالُوا هَذَا مِنْ تَعْلِيمِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ

items.e: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the prayer of ‘al-Istisqa’ (the prayer for rain). Imam (a.s) said: “It is like the (prayer of) two Eid prayers. In both of them, recitation is done and takbirs are pronounced. The Imam goes out and appears in a clean place with calmness, dignity, humility, and supplication. The people go out with him. Then he praises Allah (swt), glorifies Him (azj), and extols Him (azj), and strives earnestly in supplication and increases in tasbih (‘Subhanallah’), tahlil (‘La ilaha illallah’), and takbir (‘Allahu Akbar’). Then he performs a prayer like the Eid prayer, two rak’ahs with supplication, entreaty, and striving (in prayer). Then when the Imam finishes (with salam), he turns his garment inside out and places the side that was on the right shoulder onto the left shoulder, and the one that was on the left shoulder onto the right shoulder for indeed the Prophet (saws), peace be upon him and his family, did so.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ اَلاِسْتِسْقَاءِ قَالَ« مِثْلُ صَلاَةِ اَلْعِيدَيْنِ يُقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا وَ يُكَبَّرُ فِيهِمَا يَخْرُجُ اَلْإِمَامُ فَيَبْرُزُ إِلَى مَكَانٍ نَظِيفٍ فِي سَكِينَةٍ وَ وَقَارٍ وَ خُشُوعٍ وَ مَسْأَلَةٍ وَ يَبْرُزُ مَعَهُ اَلنَّاسُ فَيَحْمَدُ اَللَّهَ وَ يُمَجِّدُهُ وَ يُثْنِي عَلَيْهِ وَ يَجْتَهِدُ فِي اَلدُّعَاءِ وَ يُكْثِرُ مِنَ اَلتَّسْبِيحِ وَاَلتَّهْلِيلِ وَاَلتَّكْبِيرِ وَ يُصَلِّي مِثْلَ صَلاَةِ اَلْعِيدَيْنِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي دُعَاءٍ وَمَسْأَلَةٍ وَاِجْتِهَادٍ فَإِذَا سَلَّمَ اَلْإِمَامُ قَلَبَ ثَوْبَهُ وَ جَعَلَ اَلْجَانِبَ اَلَّذِي عَلَى اَلْمَنْكِبِ اَلْأَيْمَنِ عَلَى اَلْمَنْكِبِ اَلْأَيْسَرِ وَ اَلَّذِي عَلَى اَلْأَيْسَرِ عَلَى اَلْأَيْمَنِ فَإِنَّ اَلنَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَذَلِكَ صَنَعَ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Sayrafi, from Muhammad ibn Sufyan, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, turning his cloak inside out when He (saws) prayed for rain (istisqa). Imam (a.s) said: “It was a sign between Him (saws) and his companions, by which drought would be turned into abundance.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلسِّنْدِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى اَلصَّيْرَفِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ تَحْوِيلِ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ رِدَاءَهُ إِذَا اِسْتَسْقَى قَالَ« عَلاَمَةٌ بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ أَصْحَابِهِ يُحَوَّلُ اَلْجَدْبُ خِصْباً»

items.e: From him, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu al-Bakhtari, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, that he said: Imam Ali (a.s) said: “The established Sunnah is that the prayer for rain (istisqa) is not performed except in open lands, where people can look towards the sky, and it is not performed in mosques except in Mecca.”
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« مَضَتِ اَلسُّنَّةُ أَنَّهُ لاَ يُسْتَسْقَى إِلاَّ بِالْبَرَارِي حَيْثُ يَنْظُرُ اَلنَّاسُ إِلَى اَلسَّمَاءِ وَلاَ يُسْتَسْقَى فِي اَلْمَسَاجِدِ إِلاَّ بِمَكَّةَ»

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Safwan, who informed me: Musa ibn Bakr or Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, prayed two rak’ahs for al-Istisqa (the prayer for rain), and He (saws) began with the prayer before the sermon. He (saws) pronounced takbir seven times and then five times, and He (saws) recited aloud.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ بَكْرٍ أَوْ عَبْدُ اَللَّهِ بْنُ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ صَلَّى لِلاِسْتِسْقَاءِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ بَدَأَ بِالصَّلاَةِ قَبْلَ اَلْخُطْبَةِ وَ كَبَّرَ سَبْعاً وَ خَمْساً وَ جَهَرَ بِالْقِرَاءَةِ»

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The sermon in the prayer for rain (al-Istisqa) is before the prayer, and he pronounces takbir seven times in the first rak’ah and five times in the second.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلْخُطْبَةُ فِي اَلاِسْتِسْقَاءِ قَبْلَ اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ يُكَبِّرُ فِي اَلْأُولَى سَبْعاً وَ فِي اَلْأُخْرَى خَمْساً»

items.e: It has been narrated from the Commander of the Faithful (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s), delivered this sermon during the prayer for rain (salat al-istisqa), and Imam (a.s) said: “All praise is due to Allah (swt), the Bestower of complete blessings, the Remover of sorrow, the Creator of souls, the One who made the heavens as supports for His (azj) Throne, ‘and the mountains as pegs’ (Surah An Naba 78:7), And the earth as a resting place for His (azj) servants, and His (azj) angels ‘upon its edges’ (Surah Al Haqqah 69:17), and the bearers of His Throne upon its bounds. And by His (azj) might, He (azj) upheld the pillars of the Throne, and with His (azj) light, He (azj) caused the rays of the sun to shine, and by His (azj) radiance, He (azj) extinguished the darkness of the dense gloom. And He (azj) caused the earth to gush forth with springs, and ‘the moon as a light’ (Surah Yunus 10:5), and the stars as radiant bodies. Then He (azj) rose and took His (azj) place, and He (azj) created and perfected, and He (azj) established and reigned supreme, so that the pride of the arrogant was humbled before Him (azj), and the desperation of the destitute sought from Him (azj). O’ Allah (swt), by Your elevated rank, and Your fortified station, and Your all-reaching bounty, and Your vast path, I ask You (azj) to send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and the family of Muhammad (saws), just as He (saws) submitted to You (azj), and called towards Your worship, and fulfilled Your covenants, and executed Your commands, And followed the signs You (azj) had set forth, Your servant, Your Prophet, and Your trustee over Your covenant to Your servants, the one who upheld Your rulings, supported those who obeyed You (azj), And cut off the excuses of those who disobeyed You (azj). O’ Allah (swt), make (Prophet) Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, the one with the greatest share of Your mercy, the most radiant of those whose faces shine with the showers of Your generosity, He (saws) is the closest of the Prophets to You (azj) in rank on the Day of Resurrection, the one with the greatest portion of Your pleasure, and the one whose community has the most rows in Your gardens, as He (saws) never prostrated to stones, nor did He (saws) dedicate himself in retreat to trees, nor did He (saws) deem the taking of captives lawful, nor did He (saws) drink blood. O’ Allah (swt), we have come out to You (azj) at a time when harsh constraints have suddenly overtaken us, when hard imprisonments have driven us to You (azj), when the bonds of disgrace have gripped us, and the traces of falsehood have become firmly rooted upon us, and the harsh trials of the years have closed in on us, and the signs of generosity have failed us, and we have thirsted for the pouring down of sustenance. Yet You (azj), were the hope of the despondent and the trust of the seeker. We call upon You (azj) at a time when humanity has despaired, when the clouds have been withheld, and when the livestock have perished. O’ Ever-Living, O’ Sustainer, by the number of the trees and the stars, and the ranks of angels, and the veiled clouds, do not return us disappointed, and do not take us to account for our deeds, and do not hold us liable for our sins. Spread over us Your mercy through the driven clouds and the flourishing plants, and bestow upon Your servants the variety of fruits, and revive Your lands through the blossoming of flowers. And make Your noble angelic scribes witnesses to a rainfall from You (azj) beneficial, lasting, abundant in flow, vast in descent, a pouring and heavy rain, swift and immediate, through which You (azj) revive what has died, and restore what has passed, and bring forth by it what is yet to come. O’ Allah (swt), grant us a pouring rain, abundant and widespread, thundering and continuous, with waves beating, with springs gushing, with lightning flashing and trembling, with flowing streams and generous outpour, its descent copious and overflowing. Do not make its shade upon us a scorching wind, nor its cold upon us a destructive storm, nor its light upon us a pelting fire, nor its water salty and bitter, nor its vegetation ash-like and lifeless. O’ Allah (swt), we seek refuge in You (azj) from polytheism and its ways, from injustice and its consequences, from poverty and its motives. O’ Giver of goodness from its sources, O’ Sender of blessings from their treasures from You (azj) is the rain that brings aid, and You (azj) are the Helper, the One Whom we seek for aid, and we are the sinners, the people of faults, and You (azj) are the One whose forgiveness is sought, the Most Forgiving. We seek Your forgiveness for the ignorant sins we have committed, and we repent to You (azj) for the grave of our misdeeds. O’ Allah (swt), so send upon us a gentle, steady, plentiful rain, and water us with a sustaining, copious downpour, a wide and expansive rainfall and a blessing from the heavy rain, beneficial, that drives drops upon drops in succession, where each drop follows another, Make it not a deceptive flash in its lightning, nor a false rumble in its thunder, and not with violent winds are its flanks. Rather, it is a refreshing rain, so abundant that even the clouds are overwhelmed by its abundance. Its clouds pour forth and its skies surrender, its mist flows across the horizons, and the signs of its showers spread throughout. A rainfall from You (azj) that is life-giving, quenching, abundant, overflowing, whose plants are pure, whose crops are growing, whose branches are lush, whose yield is abundant, whose effects are spread across the lands with fertility and goodness upon its people. By it, You (azj) revive the weak among Your servants, and You (azj) bring life to the dead among Your lands, and You (azj) bless with it the extended portions of Your sustenance, and You (azj) bring forth with it the hidden treasures of Your mercy, and You (azj) extend it even to those far from among Your creation, until those in drought are enriched by its abundance, and those suffering are revived by its blessing, and the pools in the lowlands overflow, and the flowers bloom on the peaks of the hills, and the trees grow thick upon the slopes of the hills, and after despair, it becomes worthy of gratitude as a favor from among Your enveloping favors, and a blessing from among Your abundant blessings bestowed upon Your hopeful creation, and upon Your thirsty lands, and upon Your laboring animals, and upon Your neglected wild creatures. O’ Allah (swt), from You (azj) is our hope, and to You (azj) is our return. So do not withhold it from us because of what You (azj) know of our inner selves, and do not hold us accountable for what the foolish among us have done. For indeed, ‘You send down the rain after they have despaired, and You (azj) spread Your mercy. And You are the Guardian, the Praiseworthy.’ (Surah Ash Shura 42:28)” Then Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, wept and said: “My Master (azj), our mountains have dried and cracked, our land has turned dusty and grey, our animals have wandered in distress, and some among us or those among them have despaired. The cattle have gone astray and become confused in their pastures. They cry out like a grieving mother mourning her child. They have grown weary of roaming in their grazing fields, while You (azj) have withheld from them the drops of the sky. Their bones have become fragile from weakness, their flesh has vanished, their fat has melted away, and their milk has ceased. O’ Allah (swt), have mercy on the groaning of the groaner, and the yearning of the yearning one. Have mercy on their confusion in their pastures, and their moaning in their resting places.”
items.o: رُوِيَ أَنَّ أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ خَطَبَ بِهَذِهِ اَلْخُطْبَةِ فِي صَلاَةِ اَلاِسْتِسْقَاءِ فَقَالَ:« اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سَابِغِ اَلنِّعَمِ وَ مُفَرِّجِ اَلْهَمِّ وَبَارِئِ اَلنَّسَمِ اَلَّذِي جَعَلَ اَلسَّمَاوَاتِ لِكُرْسِيِّهِ عِمَاداً« وَاَلْجِبٰالَ أَوْ تٰاداً» وَاَلْأَرْضَ لِلْعِبَادِ مِهَاداً وَمَلاَئِكَتَهُ «عَلىٰ أَرْجٰائِهٰا» وَ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِهِ عَلَى أَمْطَائِهَا وَ أَقَامَ بِعِزَّتِهِ أَرْكَانَ اَلْعَرْشِ وَ أَشْرَقَ بِضَوْئِهِ شُعَاعَ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ أَطْفَأَ بِشُعَاعِهِ ظُلْمَةَ اَلْغَطْشِ وَ فَجَّرَ« اَلْأَرْضَ عُيُوناً» وَ« اَلْقَمَرَ نُوراً» وَ اَلنُّجُومَ بُهُوراً ثُمَّ عَلاَ فَتَمَكَّنَ وَ خَلَقَ فَأَتْقَنَ وَ أَقَامَ فَتَهَيْمَنَ فَخَضَعَتْ لَهُ نَخْوَةُ اَلْمُسْتَكْبِرِ وَطَلَبَتْ إِلَيْهِ خَلَّةُ اَلْمُتَمَسْكِنِ اَللَّهُمَّ فَبِدَرَجَتِكَ اَلرَّفِيعَةِ وَمَحَلَّتِكَ اَلْمَنِيعَةِ وَ فَضْلِكَ اَلْبَالِغِ وَ سَبِيلِكَ اَلْوَاسِعِ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا دَانَ لَكَ وَ دَعَا إِلَى عِبَادَتِكَ وَ أَوْفَى بِعُهُودِكَ وَ أَنْفَذَ أَحْكَامَكَ وَ اِتَّبَعَ أَعْلاَمَكَ عَبْدِكَ وَ نَبِيِّكَ وَ أَمِينِكَ عَلَى عَهْدِكَ إِلَى عِبَادِكَ اَلْقَائِمِ بِأَحْكَامِكَ وَ مُؤَيِّدِ مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ وَ قَاطِعِ عُذْرِ مَنْ عَصَاكَ اَللَّهُمَّ فَاجْعَلْ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَجْزَلَ مَنْ جَعَلْتَ لَهُ نَصِيباً مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ أَنْضَرَ مَنْ أَشْرَقَ وَجْهُهُ بِسِجَالِ عَطِيَّتِكَ وَ أَقْرَبَ اَلْأَنْبِيَاءِ زُلْفَةً يَوْمَ اَلْقِيَامَةِ عِنْدَكَ وَ أَوْفَرَهُمْ حَظّاً مِنْ رِضْوَانِكَ وَ أَكْثَرَ هُمْ صُفُوفَ أُمَّةٍ فِي جِنَانِكَ كَمَا لَمْ يَسْجُدْ لِلْأَحْجَارِ وَ لَمْ يَعْتَكِفْ لِلْأَشْجَارِ وَ لَمْ يَسْتَحِلَّ اَلسِّبَاءَ وَ لَمْ يَشْرَبِ اَلدِّمَاءَ اَللَّهُمَّ خَرَجْنَا إِلَيْكَ حِينَ فَاجَأَتْنَا اَلْمَضَايِقُ اَلْوَعْرَةُ وَ أَلْجَأَتْنَا اَلْمَحَابِسُ اَلْعَسِرَةُ وَ عَضَّتْنَا عَلاَئِقُ اَلشَّيْنِ وَ تَأَثَّلَتْ عَلَيْنَا لَوَاحِقُ اَلْمَيْنِ وَاِعْتَكَرَتْ عَلَيْنَا حَدَابِيرُ اَلسِّنِينَ وَأَخْلَفَتْنَا مَخَايِلُ اَلْجَوْدِ وَاِسْتَظْمَأْنَا لِصَوَارِخِ اَلْقَوْدِ فَكُنْتَ رَجَاءَ اَلْمُبْتَئِسِ وَاَلثِّقَةَ لِلْمُلْتَمِسِ نَدْعُوكَ حِينَ قَنَطَ اَلْأَنَامُ وَمُنِعَ اَلْغَمَامُ وَهَلَكَ اَلسَّوَامُ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ عَدَدَ اَلشَّجَرِ وَ اَلنُّجُومِ وَ اَلْمَلاَئِكَةِ اَلصُّفُوفِ وَ اَلْعَنَانِ اَلْمَكْفُوفِ وَ أَنْ لاَ تَرُدَّنَا خَائِبِينَ وَ لاَ تُؤَاخِذَنَا بِأَعْمَالِنَا وَ لاَ تُحَاصَّنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا وَ اُنْشُرْ عَلَيْنَا رَحْمَتَكَ بِالسَّحَابِ اَلْمُنْسَاقِ وَ اَلنَّبَاتِ اَلْمُونِقِ وَ اُمْنُنْ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ بِتَنْوِيعِ اَلثَّمَرَةِ وَ أَحْيِ بِلاَدَكَ بِبُلُوغِ اَلزَّهَرَةِ وَأَشْهِدْ مَلاَئِكَتَكَ اَلْكِرَامَ اَلسَّفَرَةَ سُقْيَا مِنْكَ نَافِعَةً دَائِمَةً غُزْرُهَا وَاسِعاً دَرُّهَا سَحَاباً وَابِلاً سَرِيعاً عَاجِلاً تُحْيِي بِهِ مَا قَدْ مَاتَ وَ تَرُدُّ بِهِ مَا قَدْ فَاتَ وَ تُخْرِجُ بِهِ مَا هُوَ آتٍ اَللَّهُمَّ اِسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مُمْرِعاً طَبَقاً مُجَلْجِلاً مُتَتَابِعاً خُفُوقُهُ مُنْبَجِسَةً بُرُوقُهُ مُرْتَجِسَةً هُمُوعُهُ وَ سَيْبُهُ مُسْتَدِرٌّ وَ صَوْبُهُ مُسْتَبْطِرٌ لاَ تَجْعَلْ ظِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا سَمُوماً وَ بَرْدَهُ عَلَيْنَا حُسُوماً وَ ضَوْءَهُ عَلَيْنَا رُجُوماً وَ مَاءَهُ أُجَاجاً وَ نَبَاتَهُ رَمَاداً رِمْدِداً اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ اَلشِّرْكِ وَهَوَ ادِيهِ وَاَلظُّلْمِ وَدَوَاهِيهِ وَاَلْفَقْرِ وَدَوَاعِيهِ يَا مُعْطِيَ اَلْخَيْرَاتِ مِنْ أَمَاثِلِهَا وَمُرْسِلَ اَلْبَرَكَاتِ مِنْ مَعَادِنِهَا مِنْكَ اَلْغَيْثُ اَلْمُغِيثُ وَ أَنْتَ اَلْغِيَاثُ اَلْمُسْتَغَاثُ وَ نَحْنُ اَلْخَاطِئُونَ وَ أَهْلُ اَلذُّنُوبِ وَ أَنْتَ اَلْمُسْتَغْفَرُ اَلْغَفَّارُ نَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِلْجَهَالاَتِ مِنْ ذُنُوبِنَا وَنَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ عَوَامِّ خَطَايَانَا اَللَّهُمَّ فَأَرْسِلْ عَلَيْنَا دِيمَةً مِدْرَاراً وَاِسْقِنَا اَلْغَيْثَ وَاكِفاً مِغْزَاراً غَيْثاً وَاسِعاً وَ بَرَكَةً مِنَ اَلْوَابِلِ نَافِعَةً تُدَافِعُ اَلْوَدْقَ بِالْوَدْقِ دِفَاعاً وَ يَتْلُو اَلْقَطْرُ مِنْهُ اَلْقَطْرَ غَيْرَ خُلَّبٍ بَرْقُهُ وَ لاَ مُكَذَّبٍ رَعْدُهُ وَ لاَ عَاصِفَةٍ جَنَائِبُهُ بَلْ رِيّاً يَغَصُّ بِالرِّيِّ رَبَابُهُ وَ فَاضَ فَانْصَاعَ بِهِ سَحَابُهُ وَ جَرَى آثَارُ هَيْدَبِهِ جَنَابَهُ سُقْيَا مِنْكَ مُحْيِيَةً مُرْوِيَةً مُحْفِلَةً مُفْضِلَةً زَاكِياً نَبْتُهَا نَامِياً زَرْعُهَا نَاضِراً عُودُهَا مُمْرِعَةً آثَارُهَا جَارِيَةً بِالْخِصْبِ وَ اَلْخَيْرِ عَلَى أَهْلِهَا تَنْعَشُ بِهَا اَلضَّعِيفَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ وَ تُحْيِي بِهَا اَلْمَيِّتَ مِنْ بِلاَدِكَ وَ تُنْعِمُ بِهَا اَلْمَبْسُوطَ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ وَ تُخْرِجُ بِهَا اَلْمَخْزُونَ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ تَعُمُّ بِهَا مَنْ نَأَى مِنْ خَلْقِكَ حَتَّى يُخْصِبَ لِإِمْرَاعِهَا اَلْمُجْدِبُونَ وَ يَحْيَا بِبَرَكَتِهَا اَلْمُسْنِتُونَ وَ تَتْرَعَ بِالْقِيعَانِ غُدْرَانُهَا وَ تُورِقَ ذُرَى اَلْآكَامِ زَهَرَاتُهَا وَ يَدْهَامَّ بِذُرَى اَلْآكَامِ شَجَرُهَا وَ تَسْتَحِقَّ بَعْدَ اَلْيَأْسِ شُكْراً مِنَّةً مِنْ مِنَنِكَ مُجَلِّلَةً وَنِعْمَةً مِنْ نِعَمِكَ مُفْضَلَةً عَلَى بَرِيَّتِكَ اَلْمُؤَمِّلَةِ وَبِلاَدِكَ اَلْمُغْرِبَةِ وَبَهَائِمِكَ اَلْمُعْمَلَةِ وَوَحْشِكَ اَلْمُهْمَلَةِ اَللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ اِرْتِجَاؤُنَا وَإِلَيْكَ مَآبُنَا فَلاَ تَحْبِسْهُ عَنَّا لِتَبَطُّنِكَ سَرَائِرَنَا وَلاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ اَلسُّفَهَاءُ مِنَّا فَإِنَّكَ تُنْزِلُ« اَلْغَيْثَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مٰا قَنَطُوا» وَ تَنْشُرُ رَحْمَتَكَ وَ أَنْتَ اَلْوَلِيُّ اَلْحَمِيدُ» ثُمَّ بَكَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ« سَيِّدِي صَاخَتْ جِبَالُنَا وَاِغْبَرَّتْ أَرْضُنَا وَهَامَتْ دَوَابُّنَا وَقَنَطَ نَاسٌ مِنَّا أَوْ مَنْ قَنَطَ مِنْهُمْ وَتَاهَتِ اَلْبَهَائِمُ وَتَحَيَّرَتْ فِي مَرَاتِعِهَا وَعَجَّتْ عَجِيجَ اَلثَّكْلَى عَلَى أَوْلاَدِهَا وَمَلَّتِ اَلدَّوَرَانَ فِي مَرَاتِعِهَا حِينَ حَبَسْتَ عَنْهَا قَطْرَ اَلسَّمَاءِ فَرَقَّ لِذَلِكَ عَظْمُهَا وَ ذَهَبَ لَحْمُهَا وَ ذَابَ شَحْمُهَا وَاِنْقَطَعَ دَرُّهَا اَللَّهُمَّ اِرْحَمْ أَنِينَ اَلْآنَّةِ وَحَنِينَ اَلْحَانَّةِ اِرْحَمْ تَحَيُّرَهَا فِي مَرَاتِعِهَا وَ أَنِينَهَا فِي مَرَابِضِهَا»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Amru ibn Uthman, from Ali ibn Abi Abdillah, who said: I heard Abu al-Hasan Musa (al-Kadhim (a.s)), peace be upon him, say: “When Ibrahim, the son of the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, passed away, three sunnahs (practices) were established. As for the first, when he (Ismail) died, the sun was eclipsed. So the people said: 'The sun has been eclipsed due to the loss of the son of the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family.' The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, ascended the pulpit, praised Allah (swt) and extolled Him (azj), then said: 'O people, indeed the sun and the moon are two signs from among the signs of Allah (swt). They move according to His (azj) command, obedient to Him (azj). They do not eclipse due to the death of anyone nor for his (Ismail) life. So if either of them is eclipsed, then pray.' Then Prophet (saws) descended and led the people in the prayer of ‘al-Kusuf’ (prayer of eclipse).”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« إِنَّهُ لَمَّا قُبِضَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ جَرَتْ ثَلاَثُ سُنَنٍ أَمَّا وَاحِدَةٌ فَإِنَّهُ لَمَّا مَاتَ اِنْكَسَفَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ فَقَالَ اَلنَّاسُ اِنْكَسَفَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ لِفَقْدِ اِبْنِ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَصَعِدَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ اَلْمِنْبَرَ فَحَمِدَ اَللَّهَ وَ أَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ« أَيُّهَا اَلنَّاسُ إِنَّ اَلشَّمْسَ وَ اَلْقَمَرَ آيَتَانِ مِنْ آيَاتِ اَللَّهِ يَجْرِيَانِ بِأَمْرِهِ مُطِيعَانِ لَهُ لاَ يَنْكَسِفَانِ لِمَوْتِ أَحَدٍ وَ لاَ لِحَيَاتِهِ فَإِذَا اِنْكَسَفَتَا أَوْ وَاحِدَةٌ مِنْهُمَا فَصَلُّوا» ثُمَّ نَزَلَ فَصَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ صَلاَةَ اَلْكُسُوفِ»
items.h: Chapter on the Prayer of the Eclipse

items.e: Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: We said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “These winds and darkness that occur (eclipse), is prayer to be performed for them?” Imam (a.s) said: “Every fearful occurrence in the sky whether darkness, wind, or terror, perform for it the prayer of ‘al-Kusuf’ (prayer of eclipse) until it subsides.”
items.o: حَمَّادٌ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالاَ: قُلْنَا لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ هَذِهِ اَلرِّيَاحُ وَ اَلظُّلَمُ اَلَّتِي تَكُونُ هَلْ يُصَلَّى لَهَا فَقَالَ« كُلُّ أَخَاوِيفِ اَلسَّمَاءِ مِنْ ظُلْمَةٍ أَوْ رِيحٍ أَوْ فَزَعٍ فَصَلِّ لَهُ صَلاَةَ اَلْكُسُوفِ حَتَّى يَسْكُنَ»

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Muhammad ibn Humran, who said: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “The time for the prayer of ‘al-Kusuf’ (prayer of eclipse) is at the hour when the eclipse occurs, whether at sunrise or at sunset.” He (narrator) said that Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, also said: “It is an obligation (faridah).”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حُمْرَانَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« وَقْتُ صَلاَةِ اَلْكُسُوفِ فِي اَلسَّاعَةِ اَلَّتِي تَنْكَسِفُ عِنْدَ طُلُوعِ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ عِنْدَ غُرُوبِهَا» قَالَ وَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« هِيَ فَرِيضَةٌ»

items.e: And from him, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, sometimes we are tested with an eclipse after Maghrib, before the final Isha prayer. If we perform the eclipse prayer, we fear missing the obligatory prayer.” Imam (a.s) said: “If you fear that, then interrupt your eclipse prayer and perform your obligatory prayer, then return to complete it.” I asked: “And if the eclipse occurs at the end of the night, and we perform the eclipse prayer and miss the night prayer (salat al-layl), which of the two should we begin with?” Imam (a.s) said: “Perform the eclipse prayer, and make up the night prayer when you reach the morning.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ رُبَّمَا اُبْتُلِينَا بِالْكُسُوفِ بَعْدَ اَلْمَغْرِبِ قَبْلَ اَلْعِشَاءِ اَلْآخِرَةِ فَإِنْ صَلَّيْنَا اَلْكُسُوفَ خَشِينَا أَنْ تَفُوتَنَا اَلْفَرِيضَةُ فَقَالَ« إِذَا خَشِيتَ ذَلِكَ فَاقْطَعْ صَلاَتَكَ وَ اِقْضِ فَرِيضَتَكَ ثُمَّ عُدْ فِيهَا» قُلْتُ فَإِذَا كَانَ اَلْكُسُوفُ آخِرَ اَللَّيْلِ فَصَلَّيْنَا صَلاَةَ اَلْكُسُوفِ فَاتَتْنَا صَلاَةُ اَللَّيْلِ فَبِأَيَّتِهِمَا نَبْدَأُ فَقَالَ« صَلِّ صَلاَةَ اَلْكُسُوفِ وَ اِقْضِ صَلاَةَ اَللَّيْلِ حِينَ تُصْبِحُ»

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from a group, from both of the Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, and some have narrated it from one of the Imams (a.s), peace be upon them: Imam (a.s) said: “The prayer for the eclipse of the sun, the moon, the trembling (rajfah), and the earthquake (zalzalah) is ten rak’ahs with four prostrations. The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, prayed it with the people behind him during a solar eclipse. And when He (saws) finished, the eclipse had cleared.” And the (Imams (a.s)) narrated that the prayer in all of these signs is the same, and the most intense and the longest of them is the solar eclipse. “You begin by saying the takbir to open the prayer, then you recite the ‘Umm al-Kitab’ (Surah Al Fatihah) and a surah, then you bow (rukuh), then you raise your head from the bowing and recite the ‘Umm al-Kitab’ (Surah Al Fatihah) and a surah, then you bow the second time, then you raise your head from the bowing and recite the ‘Umm al-Kitab’ (Surah Al Fatihah) and a surah, then you bow the third time, then you raise your head from the bowing and recite the ‘Umm al-Kitab’ (Surah Al Fatihah) and a surah, then you bow the fourth time, then you raise your head from the bowing and recite the ‘Umm al-Kitab’ (Surah Al Fatihah) and a surah, then you bow the fifth time. When you raise your head, you say: ‘Sami‘a Allahu liman hamidah’ (‘Allah (swt) hears the one who praises Him (azj)”), then you go down in prostration and perform two prostrations. Then you stand and do as you did in the first (unit).” He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘And if he recites one surah in the five bowings and divides it among them?’” Imam (a.s) said: “It suffices him to recite the ‘Umm al-Kitab’ (Surah Al Fatihah) the first time. And if he recites five surahs, he recites with each surah the ‘Umm al-Kitab’ (Surah Al Fatihah). As for qunut (supplication), it is done in the second rak‘ah before the bowing, after you finish the recitation. Then you perform qunut in the fourth the same way, then in the sixth, then in the eighth, then in the tenth.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ رَهْطٍ عَنْ كِلَيْهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ رَوَاهُ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّ صَلاَةَ كُسُوفِ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ اَلْقَمَرِ وَ اَلرَّجْفَةِ وَاَلزَّلْزَلَةِ عَشْرُ رَكَعَاتٍ وَ أَرْبَعُ سَجَدَاتٍ صَلاَّهَا رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ اَلنَّاسُ خَلْفَهُ فِي كُسُوفِ اَلشَّمْسِ فَفَرَغَ حِينَ فَرَغَ وَ قَدِ اِنْجَلَى كُسُوفُهَا وَ رَوَوْا أَنَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ فِي هَذِهِ اَلْآيَاتِ كُلِّهَا سَوَاءٌ وَ أَشَدُّهَا وَ أَطْوَلُهَا كُسُوفُ اَلشَّمْسِ تَبْدَأُ فَتُكَبِّرُ بِافْتِتَاحِ اَلصَّلاَةِ ثُمَّ تَقْرَأُ أُمَّ اَلْكِتَابِ وَ سُورَةً ثُمَّ تَرْكَعُ ثُمَّ تَرْفَعُ رَأْسَكَ مِنَ اَلرُّكُوعِ فَتَقْرَأُ أُمَّ اَلْكِتَابِ وَ سُورَةً ثُمَّ تَرْكَعُ اَلثَّانِيَةَ ثُمَّ تَرْفَعُ رَأْسَكَ مِنَ اَلرُّكُوعِ فَتَقْرَأُ أُمَّ اَلْكِتَابِ وَ سُورَةً ثُمَّ تَرْكَعُ اَلثَّالِثَةَ ثُمَّ تَرْفَعُ رَأْسَكَ مِنَ اَلرُّكُوعِ فَتَقْرَأُ أُمَّ اَلْكِتَابِ وَ سُورَةً ثُمَّ تَرْكَعُ اَلرَّابِعَةَ ثُمَّ تَرْفَعُ رَأْسَكَ مِنَ اَلرُّكُوعِ فَتَقْرَأُ أُمَّ اَلْكِتَابِ وَ سُورَةً ثُمَّ تَرْكَعُ اَلْخَامِسَةَ فَإِذَا رَفَعْتَ رَأْسَكَ قُلْتَ سَمِعَ اَللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ثُمَّ تَخِرُّ سَاجِداً فَتَسْجُدُ سَجْدَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ تَقُومُ فَتَصْنَعُ مِثْلَ مَا صَنَعْتَ فِي اَلْأُولَى» قَالَ قُلْتُ وَ إِنْ هُوَ قَرَأَ سُورَةً وَاحِدَةً فِي اَلْخَمْسِ رَكَعَاتٍ فَفَرَّقَهَا بَيْنَهَا قَالَ« أَجْزَأَهُ أُمُّ اَلْكِتَابِ فِي أَوَّلِ مَرَّةٍ وَ إِنْ قَرَأَ خَمْسَ سُوَرٍ قَرَأَ مَعَ كُلِّ سُورَةٍ أُمَّ اَلْكِتَابِ وَ اَلْقُنُوتُ فِي اَلرَّكْعَةِ اَلثَّانِيَةِ قَبْلَ اَلرُّكُوعِ إِذَا فَرَغْتَ مِنَ اَلْقِرَاءَةِ ثُمَّ تَقْنُتُ فِي اَلرَّابِعَةِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ فِي اَلسَّادِسَةِ ثُمَّ فِي اَلثَّامِنَةِ ثُمَّ فِي اَلْعَاشِرَةِ»

items.e: And from him, from Fadalah, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, who said: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “If you complete the eclipse prayer (salat al-kusuf) before the eclipse clears, then repeat it.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَ:« صَلاَةَ اَلْكُسُوفِ إِذَا فَرَغْتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْجَلِيَ فَأَعِدْ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan all from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said: We asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about the eclipse prayer (salat al-kusuf), about how many rak’ahs it has and how we should perform it. Imam (a.s) said: “It is ten rak’ahs and four prostrations. You begin the prayer with a takbir, and you bow with a takbir, and you raise your head with a takbir except in the fifth rak’ah in which you go into prostration; there you say: ‘SamiAllahu liman hamidah’ (‘Allah (swt) hears one who praises Him (azj)’). You perform qunut in every two rak’ahs before bowing, and you lengthen the qunut and the bowing in proportion to the length of the recitation and the bowing. If you finish before the eclipse has cleared, then sit and supplicate to Allah (swt) until it clears. And if the eclipse clears before you have finished your prayer, then complete whatever remains of your prayer. You recite aloud in this prayer.” He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘How is the recitation in it?’” Imam (a.s) said: “If you recite a surah in every rak’ah, then recite ‘Umm al-Kitab’ (Surah Al Fatihah). But if you shorten the surah and stop before completing it, then continue from where you left off, and do not repeat Surah al-Fatihah.” Imam (a.s) said: “And it was recommended in it to recite Surah al-Kahf and Surah al-Hijr unless the person is leading prayer (as an imam), in which case it may be difficult for those praying behind him. So if you are able to perform your prayer in an open space where no house covers you, then do so. And the eclipse prayer for the sun is longer than the eclipse prayer for the moon although they are equal in recitation, bowing, and prostration.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ جَمِيعاً عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالاَ: سَأَلْنَا أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ اَلْكُسُوفِ كَمْ رَكْعَةً هِيَ وَ كَيْفَ نُصَلِّيهَا فَقَالَ« هِيَ عَشْرُ رَكَعَاتٍ وَ أَرْبَعُ سَجَدَاتٍ تَفْتَتِحُ اَلصَّلاَةَ بِتَكْبِيرَةٍ وَ تَرْكَعُ بِتَكْبِيرَةٍ وَ تَرْفَعُ رَأْسَكَ بِتَكْبِيرَةٍ إِلاَّ فِي اَلْخَامِسَةِ اَلَّتِي تَسْجُدُ فِيهَا فَتَقُولُ سَمِعَ اَللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ وَ تَقْنُتُ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ اَلرُّكُوعِ وَ تُطَوِّلُ اَلْقُنُوتَ وَاَلرُّكُوعَ عَلَى قَدْرِ اَلْقِرَاءَةِ وَاَلرُّكُوعِ وَاَلسُّجُودِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنْجَلِيَ فَاقْعُدْ وَاُدْعُ اَللَّهَ حَتَّى يَنْجَلِيَ فَإِنْ تَجَلَّى قَبْلَ أَنْ تَفْرُغَ مِنْ صَلاَتِكَ فَأَتِمَّ مَا بَقِيَ تَجْهَرُ بِالْقِرَاءَةِ» قَالَ قُلْتُ كَيْفَ اَلْقِرَاءَةُ فِيهَا فَقَالَ« إِنْ قَرَأْتَ سُورَةً فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ فَاقْرَأْ فَاتِحَةَ اَلْكِتَابِ فَإِنْ نَقَصْتَ مِنَ اَلسُّورَةِ شَيْئاً فَاقْرَأْ مِنْ حَيْثُ نَقَصْتَ وَ لاَ تَقْرَأْ فَاتِحَةَ اَلْكِتَابِ» قَالَ« وَ كَانَ يَسْتَحِبُّ فِيهَا أَنْ يُقْرَأَ بِالْكَهْفِ وَ اَلْحِجْرِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ إِمَاماً يَشُقُّ عَلَى مَنْ خَلْفَهُ فَإِنِ اِسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَكُونَ صَلاَتُكَ بَارِزاً لاَ يُجِنُّكَ بَيْتٌ فَافْعَلْ وَ صَلاَةُ كُسُوفِ اَلشَّمْسِ أَطْوَلُ مِنْ صَلاَةِ كُسُوفِ اَلْقَمَرِ وَ هُمَا سَوَاءٌ فِي اَلْقِرَاءَةِ وَ اَلرُّكُوعِ وَ اَلسُّجُودِ»

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Hariz, who said: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “If the moon is eclipsed and you were unaware of it until morning, and then it reaches you (you learn about it), then if the entire moon had been darkened (ihtaraqa kulluhu), you are obligated to make up the prayer (qada). But if it had not been completely darkened, then there is no obligation upon you to make it up.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: «إِذَا اِنْكَسَفَ اَلْقَمَرُ وَ لَمْ تَعْلَمْ بِهِ حَتَّى أَصْبَحْتَ ثُمَّ بَلَغَكَ فَإِنْ كَانَ اِحْتَرَقَ كُلُّهُ فَعَلَيْكَ اَلْقَضَاءُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنِ اِحْتَرَقَ كُلُّهُ فَلاَ قَضَاءَ عَلَيْكَ»

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Hammad, from Hariz, from someone who informed him, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If the moon is eclipsed and a man wakes up but feels lazy to perform the prayer, then let him perform ghusl the next day and make up the prayer. But if he did not wake up and was unaware of the lunar eclipse, then he is only required to make up the prayer, without ghusl.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَمَّنْ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا اِنْكَسَفَ اَلْقَمَرُ فَاسْتَيْقَظَ اَلرَّجُلُ فَكَسِلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ مِنْ غَدٍ وَ لْيَقْضِ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَيْقِظْ وَ لَمْ يَعْلَمْ بِانْكِسَافِ اَلْقَمَرِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ اَلْقَضَاءُ بِغَيْرِ غُسْلٍ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Ubaydullah al-Halabi, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the eclipse prayer, do we make it up if we miss it? Imam (a.s) said: “There is no make-up (qadah) for it.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ اَلْكُسُوفِ نَقْضِي إِذَا فَاتَتْنَا قَالَ« لَيْسَ فِيهَا قَضَاءٌ» وقد كان في ايدينا انها تقضى

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If the sun is fully eclipsed and completely darkened, and you were unaware of it but came to know afterward, then you are obligated to make it up (qadah). But if it was not fully darkened, then there is no obligation upon you to make it up.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَ قَالَ:« إِذَا اِنْكَسَفَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ كُلُّهَا وَ اِحْتَرَقَتْ وَ لَمْ تَعْلَمْ وَ عَلِمْتَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَعَلَيْكَ اَلْقَضَاءُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ تَحْتَرِقْ كُلُّهَا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ قَضَاءٌ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father and Muhammad ibn Ismail from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, all from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him. He said: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “If you forget a prayer or you performed it without ablution, and there are missed prayers upon you, then begin with the first of them. Call the adhan for it and the iqamah, then pray it. After that, pray the one that follows it, with an iqamah, an iqamah for each prayer.” He (Zurarah) said: “And Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘And if you had already performed Dhuhr while the morning prayer had passed you, then you remembered it, then pray it at whatever hour you remember it, even after Asr. And whenever you remember a prayer that has passed you, then pray it.” And Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “If you forget the Dhuhr prayer until you have prayed the Asr prayer, then you remember it while you are in the prayer or after you have finished, then intend that (what you just prayed) be the first (Dhuhr), and then pray the Asr. For it is four (rak’ahs) that you have prayed in place of four. And if you remember that you did not pray the first (Dhuhr) while you are in the Asr prayer, and you have already prayed two rak’ahs of it, then complete the remaining two rak’ahs (as Dhuhr), and then stand and pray the Asr. And if you remember that you did not pray Asr, until the time of Maghrib has entered, and you do not fear missing it, then pray the Asr and then pray the Maghrib. And if you had already prayed the Maghrib, then stand and pray the Asr. And if you had already prayed two rak’ahs of Maghrib, then you remembered Asr, then intend it as Asr, then give salam, then pray Maghrib. And if you had prayed the last Isha prayer and had forgotten Maghrib, then stand and pray Maghrib. And if you remembered it and you had already prayed two rak’ahs of the last Isha or you had stood up for the third, then intend it as Maghrib, then give salam, then stand and pray the last Isha. And if you had forgotten the last Isha prayer until you prayed the fajr, then pray the last Isha prayer. And if you remembered it while you were in a rak’ah or in the second (rak’ah) of the morning prayer, then intend it as Isha, then stand and pray the morning prayer. Call the adhan and the iqamah. And if both Maghrib and Isha have passed you, then begin with them before you pray the morning prayer, then begin with Maghrib, and then Isha. And if you fear that the morning prayer will be missed if you begin with them, then begin with Maghrib, then the morning prayer, then pray Isha. And if you fear that the morning prayer will be missed if you begin with Maghrib, then pray the morning prayer, then pray Maghrib and Isha. Begin with whichever of the two came first, because both of them are qadha (make-up prayers). Whichever of them you remember, do not pray them except after the sunrise rays appear.” He (Zurarah) said: “I asked, ‘Why is that?’” Imam (a.s) said: “Because you do not fear missing it.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ جَمِيعاً عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَ قَالَ:« إِذَا نَسِيتَ صَلاَةً أَوْ صَلَّيْتَهَا بِغَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ وَكَانَ عَلَيْكَ قَضَاءُ صَلَوَاتٍُ فَابْدَأْ بِأَوَّلِهِنَّ فَأَذِّنْ لَهَا وَ أَقِمْ ثُمَّ صَلِّهَا ثُمَّ صَلِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا بِإِقَامَةٍ إِقَامَةٍ لِكُلِّ صَلاَةٍ» قَالَ وَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَ« وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ قَدْ صَلَّيْتَ اَلظُّهْرَ وَ قَدْ فَاتَتْكَ اَلْغَدَاةُ فَذَكَرْتَهَا فَصَلِّ أَيَّ سَاعَةٍ ذَكَرْتَهَا وَ لَوْ بَعْدَ اَلْعَصْرِ وَ مَتَى مَا ذَكَرْتَ صَلاَةً فَاتَتْكَ صَلَّيْتَهَا» وَ قَالَ« إِنْ نَسِيتَ اَلظُّهْرَ حَتَّى صَلَّيْتَ اَلْعَصْرَ فَذَكَرْتَهَا وَ أَنْتَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ أَوْ بَعْدَ فَرَاغِكَ فَانْوِهَا اَلْأُولَى ثُمَّ صَلِّ اَلْعَصْرَ فَإِنَّهَا هِيَ أَرْبَعٌ صَلَّيْتَهَا مَكَانَ أَرْبَعٍ وَ إِنْ ذَكَرْتَ أَنَّكَ لَمْ تُصَلِّ اَلْأُولَى وَ أَنْتَ فِي صَلاَةِ اَلْعَصْرِ وَ قَدْ صَلَّيْتَ مِنْهَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَصَلِّ اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اَلْبَاقِيَتَيْنِ وَ قُمْ فَصَلِّ اَلْعَصْرَ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ ذَكَرْتَ أَنَّكَ لَمْ تُصَلِّ اَلْعَصْرَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ وَقْتُ اَلْمَغْرِبِ وَ لَمْ تَخَفْ فَوْتَهَا فَصَلِّ اَلْعَصْرَ ثُمَّ صَلِّ اَلْمَغْرِبَ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ قَدْ صَلَّيْتَ اَلْمَغْرِبَ فَقُمْ فَصَلِّ اَلْعَصْرَ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ قَدْ صَلَّيْتَ مِنَ اَلْمَغْرِبِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ ذَكَرْتَ اَلْعَصْرَ فَانْوِهَا اَلْعَصْرَ ثُمَّ سَلِّمْ ثُمَّ صَلِّ اَلْمَغْرِبَ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ قَدْ صَلَّيْتَ اَلْعِشَاءَ اَلْآخِرَةَ وَ نَسِيتَ اَلْمَغْرِبَ فَقُمْ فَصَلِّ اَلْمَغْرِبَ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ ذَكَرْتَهَا وَ قَدْ صَلَّيْتَ مِنَ اَلْعِشَاءِ اَلْآخِرَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ أَوْ قُمْتَ فِي اَلثَّالِثَةِ فَانْوِهَا اَلْمَغْرِبَ ثُمَّ سَلِّمْ ثُمَّ قُمْ فَصَلِّ اَلْعِشَاءَ اَلْآخِرَةَ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ قَدْ نَسِيتَ اَلْعِشَاءَ اَلْآخِرَةَ حَتَّى صَلَّيْتَ اَلْفَجْرَ فَصَلِّ اَلْعِشَاءَ اَلْآخِرَةَ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ ذَكَرْتَهَا وَ أَنْتَ فِي رَكْعَةٍ أَوْ فِي اَلثَّانِيَةِ مِنَ اَلْغَدَاةِ فَانْوِهَا اَلْعِشَاءَ ثُمَّ قُمْ فَصَلِّ اَلْغَدَاةَ وَ أَذِّنْ وَ أَقِمْ وَ إِنْ كَانَتِ اَلْمَغْرِبُ وَ اَلْعِشَاءُ قَدْ فَاتَتَاكَ جَمِيعاً فَابْدَأْ بِهِمَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ اَلْغَدَاةَ اِبْدَأْ بِالْمَغْرِبِ ثُمَّ اَلْعِشَاءِ وَ إِنْ خَشِيتَ أَنْ تَفُوتَكَ اَلْغَدَاةُ إِنْ بَدَأْتَ بِهِمَا فَابْدَأْ بِالْمَغْرِبِ ثُمَّ بِالْغَدَاةِ ثُمَّ صَلِّ اَلْعِشَاءَ وَ إِنْ خَشِيتَ أَنْ تَفُوتَكَ صَلاَةُ اَلْغَدَاةِ إِنْ بَدَأْتَ بِالْمَغْرِبِ فَصَلِّ اَلْغَدَاةَ ثُمَّ صَلِّ اَلْمَغْرِبَ وَ اَلْعِشَاءَ اِبْدَأْ بِأَوَّلِهِمَا لِأَنَّهُمَا جَمِيعاً قَضَاءٌ أَيَّهُمَا ذَكَرْتَ فَلاَ تُصَلِّهِمَا إِلاَّ بَعْدَ شُعَاعِ اَلشَّمْسِ» قَالَ قُلْتُ لِمَ ذَاكَ قَالَ «لِأَ نَّكَ لَسْتَ تَخَافُ فَوْتَهُ»
items.h: Chapter on the Rulings of Missed Prayers

items.e: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) was asked about a man who prayed without purification, or who forgot a prayer and did not perform it, or who slept through it. Imam (a.s) said: “He must make it up when he remembers it, at whatever hour he remembers it whether by night or by day. And if the time of (another) prayer enters while he has not yet completed what has passed him, then let him make up (the missed prayer), so long as he does not fear that the time of the present prayer will pass. And this (present prayer) has more right, so let him perform it. Then once he has prayed it, let him pray what had previously passed him of missed prayers. And he should not perform any supererogatory (nafl) rak’ah until he has made up all of the obligatory prayers.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ صَلَّى بِغَيْرِ طَهُورٍ أَوْ نَسِيَ صَلاَةً لَمْ يُصَلِّهَا أَوْ نَامَ عَنْهَا فَقَالَ« يَقْضِيهَا إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا فِي أَيِّ سَاعَةٍ ذَكَرَهَا مِنْ لَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ فَإِذَا دَخَلَ وَقْتُ اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ لَمْ يُتِمَّ مَا قَدْ فَاتَهُ فَلْيَقْضِ مَا لَمْ يَتَخَوَّفْ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ وَقْتُ هَذِهِ اَلصَّلاَةِ اَلَّتِي قَدْ حَضَرَتْ وَ هَذِهِ أَحَقُّ فَلْيَقْضِهَا فَإِذَا قَضَاهَا فَلْيُصَلِّ مَا قَدْ فَاتَهُ مِمَّا قَدْ مَضَى وَ لاَ يَتَطَوَّعْ بِرَكْعَةٍ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ اَلْفَرِيضَةَ كُلَّهَا»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Abbas from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim. He said: I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who prayed the prayers while he was in a state of janabah (major ritual impurity), for a day or two or three, then remembered afterward. Imam (a.s) said: “He must perform purification, then call the adhan and give the iqamah for the first of them (meaning prayers performed whilst junub), then pray. After that, he gives the iqamah for each subsequent prayer and prays without (repeating) the adhan, until he completes all of his missed prayers.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ صَلَّى اَلصَّلَوَاتِ وَ هُوَ جُنُبٌ اَلْيَوْمَ وَ اَلْيَوْمَيْنِ وَ اَلثَّلاَثَ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ« يَتَطَهَّرُ وَ يُؤَذِّنُ وَ يُقِيمُ فِي أَوَّلِهِنَّ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي وَ يُقِيمُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فِي كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ فَيُصَلِّي بِغَيْرِ أَذَانٍ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ صَلاَتَهُ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from al-Halabi. He said: I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about someone who did not catch the sermon on the day of Jumu’ah (Friday). Imam (a.s) said: “He should pray two rak’ahs. But if he missed the prayer and did not catch it, then let him pray four (rak’ahs).” And Imam (a.s) said: “If you catch the imam (of prayer) before he bows in the final (rak’ah), then you have caught the prayer. But if you catch him after he has bowed, then (pray) it as Dhuhr, (which is) four (rak’ahs).”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَمَّنْ لَمْ يُدْرِكِ اَلْخُطْبَةَ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ قَالَ« يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِنْ فَاتَتْهُ اَلصَّلاَةُ فَلَمْ يُدْرِكْهَا فَلْيُصَلِّ أَرْبَعاً» وَ قَالَ« إِذَا أَدْرَكْتَ اَلْإِمَامَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ اَلْأَخِيرَةَ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكْتَ اَلصَّلاَةَ فَإِنْ أَنْتَ أَدْرَكْتَهُ بَعْدَ مَا رَكَعَ فَهِيَ اَلظُّهْرُ أَرْبَعٌ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Yusuf ibn al-Harith from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Arzami from his father Abd al-Rahman from Ja’far from his father from Jabir from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him. He said: Imam Ali (a.s) said: “Whoever catches the imam (of prayer) on the day of Friday while he is reciting the tashahhud, let him pray four (rak’ahs). And whoever catches one rak’ah, let him add to it another, in which he recites aloud.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ اَلْحَارِثِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ اَلْعَرْزَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« مَنْ أَدْرَكَ اَلْإِمَامَ يَوْمَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ هُوَ يَتَشَهَّدُ فَلْيُصَلِّ أَرْبَعاً وَ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً فَلْيُضِفْ إِلَيْهَا أُخْرَى يَجْهَرُ فِيهَا»

items.e: And what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Said from Fadalah and al-Nadr from Ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, he said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Friday (prayer) is not valid except for the one who catches both sermons.”
items.o: وَ اَلَّذِي رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ وَ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلْجُمُعَةُ لاَ تَكُونُ إِلاَّ لِمَنْ أَدْرَكَ اَلْخُطْبَتَيْنِ»

items.e: Do you not see what was narrated by al-Husayn from Fadalah from Hammad from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, He said: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Whoever catches one rak’ah has caught the Friday (prayer).”
items.o: أَ لاَ تَرَى إِلَى مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: «مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ اَلْجُمُعَةَ»

items.e: Sa’ad from Ali ibn Ismail from Safwan ibn Yahya from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) was asked about a man who prayed in congregation on the day of Friday, and when the imam (of prayer) bowed, he bowed as well, but the people pushed him toward a wall or a pillar, so he was unable to bow or prostrate until the people had raised their heads. Should he (then) bow and prostrate and catch up with the row, while the people have already stood up, or what should he do? Imam (a.s) said: “He should prostrate, then stand in the row, and there is no problem in that.”
items.o: سَعْدٌ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ اَلْحَجَّاجِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ صَلَّى فِي جَمَاعَةٍ يَوْمَ جُمُعَةٍ فَلَمَّا رَكَعَ اَلْإِمَامُ رَكَعَ وَ اَلْجَأَهُ اَلنَّاسُ إِلَى جِدَارٍ أَوْ أُسْطُوَانَةٍ فَلَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَى اَلرُّكُوعِ وَ لاَ اَلسُّجُودِ حَتَّى رَفَعَ اَلْقَوْمُ رُءُوسَهُمْ أَ يَرْكَعُ ثُمَّ يَسْجُدُ ثُمَّ يَلْحَقُ بِالصَّفِّ وَ قَدْ قَامَ اَلْقَوْمُ أَوْ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ« يَسْجُدُ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فِي اَلصَّفِّ وَ لاَ بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mualla ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha. He said: I heard Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “If the sun has passed the zenith while you are still in the city and you intend to travel, then complete (the Dhuhr prayer in full). But if you depart after the zenith, then shorten the Asr prayer.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَلَّى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْوَشَّاءِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« إِذَا زَالَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ وَأَنْتَ فِي اَلْمِصْرِ وَأَنْتَ تُرِيدُ اَلسَّفَرَ فَأَتِمَّ فَإِذَا خَرَجْتَ بَعْدَ اَلزَّوَالِ قَصِّرِ اَلْعَصْرَ».

items.e: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Faddal from Dawud ibn Farqad from Bashir al-Nabbal. He said: I went out with Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, until we reached al-Shajarah. Then Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: “O Nabbal!” I said: “At your service.” Imam (a.s) said: “It is not obligatory upon anyone in this entire camp to pray four (rak’ahs) except me and you, and that is because the time of the prayer entered before we had departed.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ فَرْقَدٍ عَنْ بَشِيرٍ اَلنَّبَّالِ قَالَ: خَرَجْتُ مَعَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ حَتَّى أَتَيْنَا اَلشَّجَرَةَ فَقَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« يَا نَبَّالُ» قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ قَالَ «إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَجِبْ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ هَذَا اَلْعَسْكَرِ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ أَرْبَعاً غَيْرِي وَ غَيْرِكَ وَ ذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ وَقْتُ اَلصَّلاَةِ قَبْلَ أَنْ نَخْرُجَ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah. He said: I said to Imam (a.s): “A man misses a prayer while he is on a journey, then remembers it while in residence.” Imam (a.s) said: “He must make up what he missed in the same manner as it was missed. If it was a prayer of travel, he performs it in residence as it was (shortened). And if it was a prayer of residence, then let him make it up during travel as a prayer of residence.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ رَجُلٌ فَاتَتْهُ صَلاَةٌ مِنْ صَلاَةِ اَلسَّفَرِ فَذَكَرَهَا فِي اَلْحَضَرِ فَقَالَ« يَقْضِي مَا فَاتَهُ كَمَا فَاتَهُ إِنْ كَانَتْ صَلاَةَ اَلسَّفَرِ أَدَّاهَا فِي اَلْحَضَرِ مِثْلَهَا وَ إِنْ كَانَتْ صَلاَةَ اَلْحَضَرِ فَلْيَقْضِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ صَلاَةَ اَلْحَضَرِ»

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Musa ibn Bakr from Zurarah from Abu Ja’far (a.s) : Imam al-Baqir (a.s) was asked about a man upon whom the time of prayer entered while he was on a journey, and he delayed the prayer until he arrived (at his destination), intending to pray it when he reached his family. Then, when he arrived, he forgot to pray it until its time had passed. Imam (a.s) said: “He should pray it as two rak’ahs, as the prayer of a traveller, because the time entered while he was traveling. It would have been appropriate for him to pray at that time.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ دَخَلَ وَقْتُ اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ هُوَ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فَأَخَّرَ اَلصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى قَدِمَ فَهُوَ يُرِيدُ يُصَلِّيهَا إِذَا قَدِمَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فَنَسِيَ حِينَ قَدِمَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَهَا حَتَّى ذَهَبَ وَقْتُهَا قَالَ« يُصَلِّيهَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ صَلاَةَ اَلْمُسَافِرِ لِأَنَّ اَلْوَقْتَ دَخَلَ وَ هُوَ مُسَافِرٌ كَانَ يَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ»

items.e: As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Said from Safwan ibn Yahya from al-Is ibn al-Qasim, he said: I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man upon whom the time of prayer enters while he is traveling, then he enters his house before having prayed it. He said: “He must pray it as four (rak’ahs).” And Imam (a.s) said: “He continues to shorten (the prayer) until he enters his house.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعِيصِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهِ وَقْتُ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ ثُمَّ يَدْخُلُ بَيْتَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَهَا قَالَ« يُصَلِّيهَا أَرْبَعاً» وَ قَالَ« لاَ يَزَالُ يُقَصِّرُ حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ بَيْتَهُ» فان هذه الرواية محمولة على انه إذا دخل وكان الوقت باقيا يجب عليه التمام فاما بعد مضي الوقت لا يجب عليه القضاء إلا حسب ما فاتته وكذلك إذا خرج إلى السفر وكان الوقت باقيا وجب عليه التقصير

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Safwan and Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ismail ibn Jabir. He said: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “The time of prayer enters upon me while I am traveling, but I do not pray until I enter (the home of) my family.” Imam (a.s) said: “Pray and complete the prayer (in full).” I asked: “What if the time of prayer enters upon me, while I am with my family, and I intend to travel, so I do not pray until I depart?” Imam (a.s) said: “Pray and shorten the prayer. And if you do not do so, then by Allah (swt), you have opposed the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَدْخُلُ عَلَيَّ وَقْتُ اَلصَّلاَةِ وَأَنَا فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فَلاَ أُصَلِّي حَتَّى أَدْخُلَ أَهْلِي قَالَ« صَلِّ وَأَتِمَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ» قُلْتُ فَدَخَلَ وَقْتُ اَلصَّلاَةِ وَأَنَا فِي أَهْلِي أُرِيدُ اَلسَّفَرَ فَلاَ أُصَلِّي حَتَّى أَخْرُجَ قَالَ« صَلِّ وَقَصِّرْ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَفْعَلْ فَقَدْ وَاَللَّهِ خَالَفْتَ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Safwan ibn Yahya and Fadalah ibn Ayyub from al-Ala ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them: Imam (a.s) was asked concerning a man who returns from a journey and the time of prayer enters upon him. Imam (a.s) said: “If he does not fear that the time will end, then let him enter and perform it in full. But if he fears that the time will expire before he enters, then let him pray and shorten (the prayer).”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى وَ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَقْدَمُ مِنَ اَلْغَيْبَةِ فَيَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهِ وَقْتُ اَلصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ« إِنْ كَانَ لاَ يَخَافُ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ اَلْوَقْتُ فَلْيَدْخُلْ فَلْيُتِمَّ وَ إِنْ كَانَ يَخَافُ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ اَلْوَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ فَلْيُصَلِّ وَ لْيُقَصِّرْ» فرغب عليه السلام بهذا الخبر في ان من لم يخف فوت الوقت في تأخير الصلاة حتى يدخل البيت يؤخرها حتى يؤديها على التمام فلولا ان فوت الوقت كان مراعى في هذا الباب لم يكن لتقييد الاتمام بهذه الحال معنى

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Abu Ja’far from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Dawud ibn al-Husayn from Abu al-Abbas al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him. He said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “A resident should not lead a traveller in prayer, nor should a traveller lead a resident. But if one is put in a situation where this occurs, and he (the traveller) leads a group of residents in prayer, then when he completes two rak’ahs, he should give salam and then take the hand of one of them and bring him forward to lead them. And if a traveller prays behind a group of residents, he should complete his prayer as two rak’ahs and give salam. And if he prays Dhuhr with them, then let him consider the first two rak’ahs as Dhuhr and the latter two as Asr.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ اَلْحُصَيْنِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْعَبَّاسِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ يَؤُمُّ اَلْحَضَرِيُّ اَلْمُسَافِرَ وَ لاَ اَلْمُسَافِرُ اَلْحَضَرِيَّ فَإِنِ اُبْتُلِيَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَأَمَّ قَوْماً حَاضِرِينَ فَإِذَا أَتَمَّ اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ سَلَّمَ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ بِيَدِ بَعْضِهِمْ فَقَدَّمَهُ فَأَمَّهُمْ وَإِذَا صَلَّى اَلْمُسَافِرُ خَلْفَ قَوْمٍ حُضُورٍ فَلْيُتِمَّ صَلاَتَهُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ يُسَلِّمُ وَ إِنْ صَلَّى مَعَهُمُ اَلظُّهْرَ فَلْيَجْعَلِ اَلْأُولَيَيْنِ اَلظُّهْرَ وَ اَلْأُخْرَيَيْنِ اَلْعَصْرَ»

items.e: And from him, from al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn al-Lului from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Abu al-Miza Humayd ibn al-Muthanna from Imran from Muhammad ibn Ali: (Muhammad ibn Ali) asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a traveller who enters into prayer with residents. Imam (a.s) said: “Let him perform his (own) prayer, then give salam, and make the last two (rak’ahs) supererogatory (nafila) prayer.”
items.o: وَعَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ اَللُّؤْلُؤِيِّ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْمِعْزَى حُمَيْدِ بْنِ اَلْمُثَنَّى عَنْ عِمْرَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ اَلْمُسَافِرِ إِذَا دَخَلَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ مَعَ اَلْمُقِيمِينَ قَالَ «فَلْيُصَلِّ صَلاَتَهُ ثُمَّ لْيُسَلِّمْ وَ لْيَجْعَلِ اَلْأُخْرَيَيْنِ سُبْحَةً»

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman. He said: I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a traveller who prays behind a resident. Imam (a.s) said: “He should pray two rak’ahs and then go wherever he wishes.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمُسَافِرِ يُصَلِّي خَلْفَ اَلْمُقِيمِ قَالَ« يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ يَمْضِي حَيْثُ شَاءَ»

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Husayn ibn Uthman from Abdillah ibn Muskan from Abu Basir. He said: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “The traveller should not pray with the resident. But if he does pray, then let him leave after two rak’ahs.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« لاَ يُصَلِّي اَلْمُسَافِرُ مَعَ اَلْمُقِيمِ فَإِنْ صَلَّى فَلْيَنْصَرِفْ فِي اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mualla ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha from Aban ibn Uthman from Umar ibn Yazid. He said: I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a traveller who prays with the imam (of prayer) and catches two rak’ahs of the prayer. Does that suffice him? Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَلَّى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْوَشَّاءِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمُسَافِرِ يُصَلِّي مَعَ اَلْإِمَامِ فَيُدْرِكُ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ أَ يُجْزِي ذَلِكَ عَنْهُ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ»

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Abbas ibn Maruf from Safwan ibn Yahya from Abdillah ibn Muskan and Muhammad ibn al-Numan al-Ahwal from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him. He said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “If a traveller joins a group of residents in their prayer, then if it is the first (Dhuhr) prayer, let him make the obligatory prayer in the first two rak’ahs. And if it is the Asr prayer, let him make the first two (rak’ahs) supererogatory and the last two obligatory.”
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ اَلْأَحْوَلِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا دَخَلَ اَلْمُسَافِرُ مَعَ أَقْوَامٍ حَاضِرِينَ فِي صَلاَتِهِمْ فَإِنْ كَانَتِ اَلْأُولَى فَلْيَجْعَلِ اَلْفَرِيضَةَ فِي اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اَلْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ وَإِنْ كَانَتِ اَلْعَصْرُ فَلْيَجْعَلِ اَلْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ نَافِلَةً وَاَلْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ فَرِيضَةً» وفقه هذا الحديث انه انما قال ان كانت الظهر فليجعل الفريضة في الركعتين الاولتين لانه متى فعل ذلك جاز له ان يجعل الركعتين الاخيرتين صلاة العصر وإذا كان صلاة العصر انما يجعل الركعتين الاخيرتين صلاته لانه يكره الصلاة بعد صلاة العصر إلا على جهة القضاء ومن صلى على ما قلناه لم يبق عليه شئ ويحتسب به من النوافل

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abbad ibn Suhayb. He said: I heard Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “A person performing tayammum should not lead a group who have performed wudu.”
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« لاَ يُصَلِّي اَلْمُتَيَمِّمُ بِقَوْمٍ مُتَوَضِّئِينَ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Bunan ibn Muhammad from his father from Ibn al-Mughirah from al-Sakuni from Imam Ja’far (a.s), from his father Imam al-Baqir (a.s), peace be upon them, said: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “A person who performs tayammum should not lead those who have performed wudu, and a person afflicted with paralysis (al-falij) should not lead those who are healthy.”
items.o: وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ بُنَانِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ يَؤُمُّ صَاحِبُ اَلتَّيَمُّمِ اَلْمُتَوَضِّئِينَ وَ لاَ يَؤُمُّ صَاحِبُ اَلْفَالِجِ اَلْأَصِحَّاءَ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid from Abu Jamilah from Abu Usamah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said concerning a man who enters a state of janabah (major ritual impurity) and has no water, and he is the imam (of prayer) of the people. Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, he performs tayammum and leads them in prayer.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ :فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُجْنِبُ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ مَاءٌ وَ هُوَ إِمَامُ اَلْقَوْمِ قَالَ« نَعَمْ يَتَيَمَّمُ وَ يَؤُمُّهُمْ»

items.e: And among them is what was narrated by Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Said from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Abdillah ibn Bukayr. He said: I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s) about a man who entered a state of janabah, then performed tayammum and led us in prayer while we were in a state of full purity. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in it.”
items.o: وَ مِنْهُ مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَجْنَبَ ثُمَّ تَيَمَّمَ فَأَمَّنَا وَ نَحْنُ طَهُورٌ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ»

items.e: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Said from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Muhammad ibn Humran and Jamil ibn Darraj. They said: I said to Aba Abdillah (a.s): “An imam (of prayer) of a group, who becomes junub (ritually impure due to major impurity) during travel, and does not have enough water for ghusl, should someone among them who has wudu lead them in prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: “No. Rather, the one in a state of janabah should perform tayammum and lead them in prayer, for Allah (swt), Mighty and Exalted, has made the earth a purifier.”
items.o: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حُمْرَانَ وَجَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِمَامُ قَوْمٍ أَصَابَتْهُ جَنَابَةٌ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ مِنَ اَلْمَاءِ مَا يَكْفِيهِ لِلْغُسْلِ أَ يَتَوَضَّأُ بَعْضُهُمْ وَ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ فَقَالَ« لاَ وَ لَكِنْ تَيَمَّمَ اَلْجُنُبُ وَ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ فَإِنَّ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ جَعَلَ اَلتُّرَابَ طَهُوراً»

items.e: And from him, from Abu Ja’far from his father from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah from Abdillah ibn Bukayr from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him. He said: I said to Imam (a.s): “A man led a group in prayer while he was in a state of janabah and had performed tayammum, while they were in a state of full purification (taharah).” Imam (a.s) said: “There is no harm in it.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ رَجُلٌ أَمَّ قَوْماً وَ هُوَ جُنُبٌ وَ قَدْ تَيَمَّمَ وَ هُمْ عَلَى طَهُورٍ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali from Amru ibn Said from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar al-Sabati from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him. He said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked about a man who repeats a prayer does he also repeat the adhan and the iqamah? Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَ قَالَ: سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ إِذَا أَعَادَ اَلصَّلاَةَ هَلْ يُعِيدُ اَلْأَذَانَ وَ اَلْإِقَامَةَ قَالَ« نَعَمْ»

items.e: Ali ibn Mahziyar from al-Hasan ibn Ali from Fadalah from Muawiyah ibn Ammar. He said: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me (Ibn Ammar): “Make up what you missed of the daytime prayer during the day, and what you missed of the night prayer during the night.” I asked: “Should I make up two witr prayers in one night?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes, always make up the witr prayer.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« اِقْضِ مَا فَاتَكَ مِنْ صَلاَةِ اَلنَّهَارِ بِالنَّهَارِ وَ مَا فَاتَكَ مِنْ صَلاَةِ اَللَّيْلِ بِاللَّيْلِ» قُلْتُ أَقْضِي وَتْرَيْنِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ اِقْضِ وَتْراً أَبَداً»

items.e: And from him, from al-Hasan from Fadalah and al-Hasan from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Ala from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him. He said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Make up the daytime prayer at whatever hour you wish whether by night or by day all of that is the same.”
items.o: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ وَ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اِقْضِ صَلاَةَ اَلنَّهَارِ أَيَّ سَاعَةٍ شِئْتَ مِنْ لَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ كُلُّ ذَلِكَ سَوَاءٌ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Habib. He said: I wrote to Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him: “I have missed the supererogatory prayers (nafilah), when should I make them up?” So Imam al-Ridha (a.s) wrote: “Whenever you wish by night or by day.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبِيبٍ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ تَكُونُ عَلَيَّ اَلصَّلاَةُ اَلنَّافِلَةُ مَتَى أَقْضِيهَا فَكَتَبَ« أَيَّ سَاعَةٍ شِئْتَ مِنْ لَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him. He said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The prayer during travel is two rak’ahs, there is nothing before them nor after them, except for Maghrib. For after Maghrib, are four rak’ahs; do not leave them out whether in residence or travel. And there is no make-up upon you for the daytime prayers, but pray the night prayer and make it up (if missed).”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَ بِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَ قَالَ:« اَلصَّلاَةُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ رَكْعَتَانِ لَيْسَ قَبْلَهُمَا وَ لاَ بَعْدَ هُمَا شَيْءٌ إِلاَّ اَلْمَغْرِبَ فَإِنَّ بَعْدَهَا أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ لاَ تَدَعْهُنَّ فِي حَضَرٍ وَ لاَ سَفَرٍ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ قَضَاءُ صَلاَةِ اَلنَّهَارِ وَ صَلِّ صَلاَةَ اَللَّيْلِ وَ اِقْضِهِ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Safwan from al-Is ibn al-Qasim. He said: I asked Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who was traveling and performed the prayer in full. Imam (a.s) said: “If it is still within the time (of the prayer), then he should repeat it. But if the time has already passed, then no (he does not need to repeat it).”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اَلْعِيصِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ صَلَّى وَ هُوَ مُسَافِرٌ فَأَتَمَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ قَالَ« إِنْ كَانَ فِي وَقْتٍ فَلْيُعِدْ وَ إِنْ كَانَ اَلْوَقْتُ قَدْ مَضَى فَلاَ»

items.e: Sa’ad from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ali ibn al-Numan from Suwayd al-Qalla from Abu Ayyub from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him. He said: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about a man who forgets and prays four rak’ahs while traveling. Imam (a.s) said: “If he remembers on the same day, then let him repeat (the prayer). But if he does not remember until that day has passed, then there is no repetition upon him.”
items.o: سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَنْ سُوَيْدٍ اَلْقَلاَّءِ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَنْسَى فَيُصَلِّي فِي اَلسَّفَرِ أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ قَالَ« إِنْ كَانَ ذَكَرَ فِي ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمِ فَلْيُعِدْ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ حَتَّى يَمْضِيَ ذَلِكَ اَلْيَوْمُ فَلاَ إِعَادَةَ عَلَيْهِ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad ibn Isa. He said: I heard Aba Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, being asked about prayer on a ship. Imam (a.s) said: “If you are able to go out onto dry land, then go out. But if you are not able, then pray standing, and if you cannot, then pray sitting. And strive to face the qiblah.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يُسْأَلُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي اَلسَّفِينَةِ فَيَقُولُ« إِنِ اِسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَنْ تَخْرُجُوا إِلَى اَلْجَدَدِ فَاخْرُجُوا وَ إِنْ لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا فَصَلُّوا قِيَاماً وَ إِنْ لَمْ تَسْتَطِيعُوا فَصَلُّوا قُعُوداً وَ تَحَرَّوُا اَلْقِبْلَةَ»
items.h: Chapter on the Prayer in the Ship

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Said from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhari from Ibn Abi Hamzah from Ali ibn Ibrahim said: I asked Imam (a.s) about prayer on a boat. Imam (a.s) said: “He should pray while sitting if he is unable to stand in the boat, and he should not pray in the boat if he is able to reach the shore.” And Imam (a.s) said: “He should pray in the boat, turning his face towards the qiblah, then he may continue the prayer however the boat turns.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْجَوْهَرِيِّ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي اَلسَّفِينَةِ قَالَ« يُصَلِّي وَ هُوَ جَالِسٌ إِذَا لَمْ يُمْكِنْهُ اَلْقِيَامُ فِي اَلسَّفِينَةِ وَ لاَ يُصَلِّي فِي اَلسَّفِينَةِ وَ هُوَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى اَلشَّطِّ» وَ قَالَ« يُصَلِّي فِي اَلسَّفِينَةِ يُحَوِّلُ وَجْهَهُ إِلَى اَلْقِبْلَةِ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي كَيْفَ مَا دَارَتْ»

items.e: From him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu Ayyub. He said: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “We were afflicted with a situation, and we were on a boat, and evening came upon us while we were unable to find a place where we could disembark.” So Imam (a.s) said: “The people of the boat do not pray during the day, as long as they hope to disembark.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “My father (Imam al-Baqir (a.s)) used to say: ‘That is the prayer of Nuh (a.s), peace be upon him.’ And are you not pleased to pray the prayer of Nuh (a.s)?” I said: “Yes, may I be your ransom.” Imam (a.s) said: “Do not let your heart be constricted, for Nuh (a.s) prayed on the boat.” I asked: “While standing or sitting?” Imam (a.s) said: “Rather, (it was whilst) standing.” I asked: “Sometimes I face the qiblah, then the boat turns.” Imam (a.s) said: “Strive to face the qiblah with the best of your effort.”
